events.name: SENIOR'S LUNCH
events.description: Kick off the festival with a hot lunch of corn chowder and homemade biscuits. Sponsored by Mary's Cornwall Bakery.

events.name: CORNHOLE TOURNAMENT
events.description: Friendly Cornfest competition involving washers and bags. Pre-registration is required; the caption gives 902-628-6260 for registration.

events.name: 1ST SENIORS RECREATIONAL PICKLEBALL TOURNAMENT
events.description: The first annual recreational pickleball tournament, designed for recreational players aged 50 and over.

events.name: DESSERT BINGO
events.description: Bingo prizes are treats from Mary's Bakery.

events.name: ADULT TRIVIA
events.description: Hosted by Greg Lucas. Pre-registration is required; the caption gives 902-628-6260 for registration. Doors open at 7:00 PM; cash bar.

events.name: COMMUNITY FARMERS MARKET / YARD SALE
events.description: People with garden vegetables or items for sale can register their address or book a table at the Civic Centre for the event to be advertised.

events.name: CHOCOLATE BAR BINGO
events.description: Bring one chocolate bar to exchange for bingo cards; chocolate bars will also be available. Open to all ages.

events.name: CLYDE RIVER GOLF COURSE AMAZING RACE CHALLENGE
events.description: Teams of two to four search through Cornwall and surrounding areas, completing challenges to get their next clue. Pre-registration is required; the caption gives 902-628-6260 for registration.

events.name: SAM'S FAMILY FUN DAY
events.description: Family-friendly Cornfest activities include inflatables, balloon twisting by Top Hat, a corn boil, and barbecue. The same-day program lists the Corn Shucking Competition at 1:30 PM and entertainment by HACHE from 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM.

events.name: CORN SHUCKING COMPETITION
events.description: Youth and adult competitions for the “King or Queen of the Corn” title. The schedule says to stick around for the community corn boil. The Town Hall venue is carried over from the immediately preceding Sam's Family Fun Day listing.
